name: The 20th-Century Architecture of Frank Lloyd Wright
description: Eight buildings spread across six U.S. states, this collection showcases Frank Lloyd Wright's vision of architecture that blends with its surroundings. It includes Fallingwater, a house in Pennsylvania cantilevered over a waterfall, and New York's spiral-ramped Guggenheim Museum. Built between 1908 and 1959, they range from a concrete church to private homes, all with open, flowing interiors.
